text:
The combination of a continuous "machine-like" heart murmur, chorioretinitis (cloudy lenses), and sensorineural hearing loss strongly points to congenital syphilis rather than rubella, which typically presents with cataracts and a patent ductus arteriosus but less commonly with this specific triad. I will request specific serological testing to confirm the presence of Treponema pallidum.

REQUEST TEST: VDRL, RPR, FTA-ABS

speaker: Doctor
text:

speaker: Doctor

The positive Rubella IgM confirms the presence of a congenital rubella infection, which aligns perfectly with the classic triad of cataracts, patent ductus arteriosus, and sensorineural hearing loss.
